entities.summary: Aleysk is a town in Altai Krai, Russia, located on the Aley River, 120 kilometers (75 mi) southwest of Barnaul. Population: 29,510 (2010 census); 28,551 (2002 census); 30,309 (1989 Soviet census); 32,000 (1968).
